 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Onkar Nath  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Tarkeshwar Nath Thakur  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 3 16-02-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
Despite valid service of notice, nobody appears on behalf of O.P. No.2.
The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Section 341, 323, 498A, 504, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
Petitioner, who is husband of opposite party no2., is said to have assaulted and tortured the opposite party no.2 in association of his family members over the dowry demand.
Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.55602 of 2022(3) dt.16-02-2023
opennyai_summary.16_February_2023__arguments:
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is an innocent person and has committed no offence.
Petitioner has neither made any dowry demand nor drove her out of her matrimonial home nor tormented her over the demand of dowry.
The petitioner has relied upon the judgment of this Court in the case of Md. Naimul Haque Ansari @ Naimul Haque Ansari & Ors. Vs. The State of Bihar, reported in Vikash Pandey vs The State Of Bihar on 16 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27613634/
1 2006 (3) PLJR 182.
opennyai_summary.16_February_2023__decision:
In that view of the matter, let the above named petitioner, be released on bail, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court below where the case is pending/successor Court in connection with Obra P.S. Case No.46 of 2022 (G.R. No.109 of 2022), subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.,
If so advised, either of the parties will be at liberty to make an application before the learned Court below for referring the matter to the District Mediation Center for the purpose of Patna High Court CR.
Accordingly, this application stands disposed of.

2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Section 341, 323, 498A, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3.
opennyai_summary.facts:
Petitioner, who is husband of informant/complainant, is said to have ousted her from the matrimonial home in association of his family members over the dowry demand.
Petitioner is ready to pay Rs.3000.00 (Rupees Three Thousand) per month to the informant/complainant in the second week of every month.
opennyai_summary.final__arguments:
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is an innocent person and has committed no offence.
Petitioner has neither made any dowry demand nor drove her out of her matrimonial home nor tormented her over Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.65889 of 2024(2)
dt.03-10-2024 the demand of dowry.
The petitioner has relied upon the judgment of this Court in the case of Md. Naimul Haque Ansari @ Naimul Haque Ansari & Ors. Vs. The State of Bihar,
reported in 2006 (3) PLJR 182.
5.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
In that view of the matter, let the above named petitioner, be released on bail, in the event of his Vikash Pandey vs The State Of Bihar on 3 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191273143/
1 arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court below where the case is pending/successor Court in connection with Dawath P.S. Case No.54 of 2024, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.,
6.
If the petitioner fails to pay the aforesaid amount on two consecutive months, informant/complainant shall be at liberty to move before the learned Court below for cancelling the bail bond of the petitioner.
7. It goes without saying that the aforesaid payment shall be subject to any order being passed in matrimonial maintenance Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.65889 of 2024(2) dt.03-10-2024 case or any other collateral proceedings.
If she fails to furnish the same, the aforesaid amount will be deposited in the learned Court below which will be released in favour of the informant/complainant after she furnishes her bank account details.
9. If so advised, either of the parties will be at liberty to make an application before the learned Court below for referring the matter to the District Mediation Center for the purpose of reconciliation or one time settlement.
10. With the aforesaid observation and direction, this application stands disposed of.
